# Adam Stepanek

> Salesforce solution builder focused on maintainable platform systems, developer tooling, and practical interfaces for AI agents.

Canonical profile: https://www.stepanek.dev
Location: Czech Republic
Current role: Salesforce Developer at Carvago.com

## Core expertise

- Salesforce solution design and architecture
- Apex and Lightning Web Components
- Model Context Protocol and AI-agent interfaces
- Experience Cloud and workflow automation
- Developer tooling and AI-assisted software delivery
- Salesforce integrations, CI/CD, and DevOps Center
- Screen Flow and accessible platform interfaces

## Selected work

- salesforce-mcp-lib: Native Apex framework connecting Salesforce to MCP-compatible AI agents. https://github.com/Damecek/salesforce-mcp-lib
- Force Navigator Reloaded: Keyboard-first command palette for Salesforce Lightning. https://github.com/Damecek/force-navigator-reloaded
- Zed Salesforce Extension: Apex language support for the Zed editor. https://github.com/Damecek/zed-salesforce-extension
- Salesforce Documentation Context: Salesforce documentation prepared for AI coding workflows. https://github.com/Damecek/salesforce-documentation-context
- Screen Flow Navigation Button: Reusable navigation controls for Salesforce Screen Flow. https://appexchange.salesforce.com/appxListingDetail?listingId=a0N3u00000RMYTpEAP
- Brag Application: Lightning Web Runtime site for recording professional achievements. https://brag-app-dev-ed.my.site.com/
